categories.title: OpenBridge · Automation (P&ID)
categories.description: Process equipment and pipes, placed on the 24 px P&ID grid by their anchor point.

categories.title: OpenBridge · Instruments
categories.description: Gauges, instrument fields and trends showing a process value.

categories.title: OpenBridge · Charts
categories.description: Live charts: rolling line/area trends of a tag, pie/donut/radial bars of several tags.

categories.title: OpenBridge · Controls
categories.description: Operator commands: buttons, start/stop and toggle switches, slider, number input, mode selector.

categories.title: OpenBridge · Alerts and status
categories.description: Alert icon, alert button, alert frame, status indicator, badge, tag label and clock.
